name: Do I need a site evaluation for a smaller renovation, or only large-scale projects?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a site evaluation for a smaller renovation, or only large-scale projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: While AKN Design Group specializes in substantial, coordinated residential renovations, a site evaluation is particularly valuable for any project that involves structural changes, significant layout modifications, or extensive utility work, regardless of perceived size. For instance, even a luxury bathroom remodel might involve rerouting plumbing or modifying wall structures, making a site assessment crucial. This upfront analysis ensures that all aspects of your project, from a custom kitchen to an outdoor living space, are planned meticulously, aligning with our commitment to a managed process and expert craftsmanship. It's about establishing a solid foundation for any significant home improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: A site evaluation is valuable for any renovation involving structural changes or extensive utility work, ensuring meticulous planning for projects of all scales.
